address: Moselstraße 27, Reil an der Mosel, 56861, Germany
bio: The food served in this 300-year-old restaurant is honest, fresh and full of flavour. Classic and regional cuisine is served throughout the day (kitchen opening hours: 12-8.30pm), taking the form of dishes such as cod à la grenobloise with spinach and mashed potatoes or Original Wiener Schnitzel with fried potatoes, salad and cranberries. You will be able to find just the right Moselle wine to accompany your meal. Service comes courtesy of a friendly and proficient team, the atmosphere is pleasant, and in summer, the wonderful terrace with a view of the vineyards and Moselle beckons. The Reiler Hof hotel has lovely guestrooms....
